verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents search operators and complex search queries, and says its AI can search your entire email history. However, it imports only the last 90 days of email by default, and community reports say older mail doesn't appear in search on the free plan, so full-history coverage is conditional. Missing for 10: evidence of ranked/relevance-ordered results, evidence of search speed, a documented list of operators and filters, full-history search without plan caveats, and hands-on corroboration of search precision.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: Search operators in Shortwave make locating threads and messages simple.
